_doc: Expected Qwen3-TTS output pace per voice, in seconds of audio per letter (letters = characters for which str.isalnum() is True). The gateway (TTS_PACE_FILE), bench/bench_tts.py (--pace-file) and the QC sidecar read this file; a voice missing here falls back to its reference clip's pace. Calibrated 2026-09-25 04:50 PKT from results/P2_matrix: the median s/letter of all successful takes of sizes short..xlong on vLLM-Omni 0.28 (xxlong Urdu excluded: those takes skip text, see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md). Before that, a prior (trump 0.0795 = the reference clip, shehbaz 0.088 from the Kaggle runs) was used by phases P0-P3.

trump.source: P2_matrix: n=482 takes short..xxlong, median 0.0699 (per size 0.068-0.077, p10-p90 0.060-0.10); the reference clip is 0.0795

shehbaz.source: P2_matrix: n=413 takes short..xlong, median 0.111 (per size 0.105-0.118, p10-p90 0.093-0.145); the reference clip (a slow, pause-heavy address) is 0.183; xxlong takes that finished ran at 0.066 (skipped text)
